hook.name: StrategicHook
hook.description: A Uniswap V4 hook for Strategic Reserve ETH/token pools that collects swap fees (buy fees decay over time from a starting rate to a floor; sell fees are constant) and distributes them across the reserve contract, a reserve vault, the V1 reserve, V1 vault, and an optional community address. Exact-output swaps are disallowed; buy-direction fees are converted to ETH via a nested pool swap before distribution.
